nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO steps VIN_5V down to VCC_3V3 for MCU, transceiver, and flash. Input and output need bypass caps. This module is the VCC_3V3 distribution hub.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: GD32F103 MCU. Uses UART1 to communicate with RS485 transceiver. Uses SPI to interface with flash for logging. RS485 direction control (DE/RE) uses GPIO. BOOT0 pulled low for Flash boot. NRST needs pull-up + filter cap.

nodes.name: rs485_transceiver
nodes.description: SP3485 RS485 transceiver. Connects MCU UART to RS485 bus. DE/RE pins controlled by MCU GPIO for direction (transmit/receive). DI and RO connect point-to-point to MCU UART_TX and UART_RX respectively. A and B outputs drive bus with external termination network (120 Ω). Bus side biasing policy defined by this module; pull-up/pull-down resistors should be placed at this module's A/B pins.

nodes.name: A
nodes.description: Non-inverting driver output / receiver input, RS-485 bus line

nodes.name: B
nodes.description: Inverting driver output / receiver input, RS-485 bus line

nodes.name: flash
nodes.description: W25Q128JV SPI NOR Flash for communication logging. CS pin controlled by MCU GPIO. WP and HOLD pins can be tied to VCC via pull-up resistors to disable protection functions.

nodes.name: WP
nodes.description: Write Protect, active low (IO2 in Quad). Tie to VCC if unused.

nodes.name: HOLD
nodes.description: Hold/Reset, active low (IO3 in Quad). Tie to VCC if unused.
